name: Taiwan Mobile Co., Ltd.
description: Taiwan Mobile Co., Ltd. provides telecommunications, broadband, retail, digital, and financial services in Taiwan and internationally. It operates through Telecommunications, Retail, Cable Television and Broadband, and Others segments. The company provides 5g, postpaid, prepaid, e-sim, international call, international roaming, and gaming services. Taiwan Mobile Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
